label: Plato, Timaeus 52a–d: Timaeus distinguishes stable intelligible being, its generated sensible…
interpretation: Bounded source reading, retained as prose because this issue supplies no adequate formal semantics for the methodological or contextual content. Timaeus distinguishes stable intelligible being, its generated sensible namesake/image, and the receptacle or space. The Forms vocabulary models only the first-to-second relation; it does not erase the third kind or purport to exhaust the passage.
